evidence.reason: The supplied `BRANCH` regex requires an ASCII alphanumeric first and last character, so Git-valid refs such as `_staging` and `release-` cannot pass a full-name validation. Because `default_branch` is parsed fail-closed, a configured repo using such a branch is rejected before use. That is an implementation defect in intended branch validation, not a new requirement; the existing invalids (`-main`, `a..b`, `a//b`, `refs.lock`) remain invalid under Git ref-name rules.
